mapper.sql: SELECT sys09_code AS cd , sys09_name AS nm FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = '${kind}' AND ( ( COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') = 'true' AND sys09_company_id = 0 ) OR ( COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') != 'true' AND sys09_company_id = #{c.companyId} ) ) AND sys09_apply_date <= f_today() AND ( ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'true' AND sys09_close_date >= f_today() ) OR ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') != 'true' ) )

t1.fnd01_fund_code_id AS fund_code_id , t2.fnd02_fund_info_id AS fund_info_id , t1.fnd01_fund_cd AS fund_code , t2.fnd02_fund_nm AS fund_name , t2.fnd02_kofia_fund_type_cd AS kofia_fund_type_code , f_cdnm('IcamFundType', t2.fnd02_kofia_fund_type_cd, t1.fnd01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS kofia_fund_type_name , CAST(t1.fnd01_start_date AS date) AS start_date , CAST(t1.fnd01_end_date AS date) AS end_date , t1.fnd01_close_yn AS close_yn , f_cdnm('PlnClosedFundCode', t1.fnd01_close_yn, t1.fnd01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS close_name , t2.fnd02_kofia_trust_cd AS kofia_trust_code , f_cdnm('IcamTrustCode', t2.fnd02_kofia_trust_cd, t1.fnd01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS kofia_trust_name , t2.fnd02_kofia_public_cd AS kofia_public_code , f_cdnm('IcamPublicCode', t2.fnd02_kofia_public_cd, t1.fnd01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS kofia_public_name , t2.fnd02_org_code_nm AS org_code_name , t2.fnd02_operator1 AS operator1 , t2.fnd02_operator2 AS operator2 , t1.fnd01_real_fund_id AS real_fund_id , t3.fnd01_fund_cd AS real_fund_code , f_get_fund_nm2(t3.fnd01_fund_code_id, f_today()) AS real_fund_name , CAST(t2.fnd02_work_date AS date) AS work_date , t2.fnd02_plan_investor_dscr AS plan_investor_dscr , t2.fnd02_plan_note AS plan_note , t1.fnd01_note AS note , t1.fnd01_icam_yn AS icam_yn , t1.fnd01_company_id AS company_id

FROM fnd01_fund_code t1 INNER JOIN fnd02_fund_info t2 ON t1.fnd01_fund_code_id = t2.fnd02_fund_code_id LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd01_fund_code t3 ON t3.fnd01_fund_code_id = t1.fnd01_real_fund_id WHERE t1.fnd01_company_id = #{companyId} AND t1.fnd01_plan_yn = 'true' AND t2.fnd02_work_date = f_max_workdate(t2.fnd02_fund_code_id, f_trunc(f_sysdate()))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fnd01_fund_code (fnd01_fund_code_id, fnd01_company_id, fnd01_fund_cd, fnd01_start_date, fnd01_end_date, fnd01_close_yn, fnd01_plan_yn, fnd01_real_fund_id, fnd01_note) VALUES (#{fundCodeId}, #{companyId}, #{r.fundCode}, #{r.startDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{r.endDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{r.closeYn}, 'true', #{r.realFundId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{r.note})

INSERT INTO fnd02_fund_info (fnd02_fund_info_id, fnd02_fund_code_id, fnd02_work_date, fnd02_fund_nm, fnd02_kofia_fund_type_cd, fnd02_kofia_trust_cd, fnd02_kofia_public_cd, fnd02_operator1, fnd02_operator2, fnd02_plan_investor_dscr, fnd02_plan_note) VALUES (#{fundInfoId}, #{fundCodeId}, #{r.workDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{r.fundName}, #{r.kofiaFundTypeCode}, #{r.kofiaTrustCode}, #{r.kofiaPublicCode}, #{r.operator1}, #{r.operator2}, #{r.planInvestorDscr}, #{r.planNote})
mapper.update: UPDATE fnd02_fund_info SET fnd02_fund_nm = #{r.fundName}, fnd02_kofia_fund_type_cd = #{r.kofiaFundTypeCode}, fnd02_kofia_trust_cd = #{r.kofiaTrustCode}, fnd02_kofia_public_cd = #{r.kofiaPublicCode}, fnd02_operator1 = #{r.operator1}, fnd02_operator2 = #{r.operator2}, fnd02_plan_investor_dscr = #{r.planInvestorDscr}, fnd02_plan_note = #{r.planNote} WHERE fnd02_fund_info_id = #{r.fundInfoId} AND fnd02_fund_code_id = #{fundCodeId}
mapper.select: WITH closeFund AS ( ) , kofiaFundType AS ( ) SELECT t1.fnd01_fund_code_id AS fund_code_id , t1.fnd01_fund_cd AS fund_code , t2.fnd02_fund_nm AS fund_name , kofiaFundType.nm AS kofia_fund_type_name , CAST(t1.fnd01_start_date AS date) AS start_date , CAST(t1.fnd01_end_date AS date) AS end_date , closeFund.nm AS close_name , t2.fnd02_org_code_nm AS org_code_name , t2.fnd02_operator1 AS operator1 , t1.fnd01_note AS note FROM fnd01_fund_code t1 INNER JOIN fnd02_fund_info t2 ON t1.fnd01_fund_code_id = t2.fnd02_fund_code_id LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd03_consignment ON ( fnd03_consignment_cd = t2.fnd02_consignment_cd AND fnd03_company_id = t1.fnd01_company_id ) LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd06_office_work ON ( fnd06_office_work_cd = t2.fnd02_office_work_cd AND fnd06_company_id = t1.fnd01_company_id ) LEFT OUTER JOIN closeFund ON closeFund.cd = t1.fnd01_close_yn LEFT OUTER JOIN kofiaFundType ON kofiaFundType.cd = t2.fnd02_kofia_fund_type_cd WHERE 1=1 AND t2.fnd02_work_date = f_max_workdate(t2.fnd02_fund_code_id, f_trunc(f_sysdate())) AND t1.fnd01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND COALESCE(t1.fnd01_close_yn,'false') IN ('false', #{c.closeYn}) AND t2.fnd02_kofia_fund_type_cd LIKE #{c.fundTypeCode} AND COALESCE(t2.fnd02_kofia_class_type_cd, '%') LIKE #{c.classTypeCode} AND t1.fnd01_plan_yn = 'true' AND COALESCE(t1.fnd01_icam_yn,'false') LIKE '%' AND UPPER(CONCAT(t1.fnd01_fund_cd, t2.fnd02_fund_nm, t2.fnd02_kofia_fund_cd, t2.fnd02_ksd_fund_cd, fnd03_consignment_nm, fnd06_office_work_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{c.fundName}) ORDER BY t1.fnd01_fund_cd

WITH closeFund AS ( ) , kofiaFundType AS ( ) SELECT tt.fnd01_fund_code_id AS fund_code_id , tt.fnd01_fund_cd AS fund_code , tt.fnd02_fund_nm AS fund_name , kofiaFundType.nm AS kofia_fund_type_name , CAST(tt.fnd01_start_date AS date) AS start_date , CAST(tt.fnd01_end_date AS date) AS end_date , closeFund.nm AS close_name , tt.fnd02_org_code_nm AS org_code_name , tt.fnd02_operator1 AS operator1 , tt.fnd01_note AS note FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT t.fnd01_fund_code_id, t.fnd01_fund_cd, t.fnd01_start_date, t.fnd01_end_date, t.fnd01_close_yn, t.fnd01_note, fnd02_fund_info.fnd02_fund_nm, fnd02_fund_info.fnd02_kofia_fund_type_cd, fnd02_fund_info.fnd02_org_code_nm, fnd02_fund_info.fnd02_operator1 FROM fnd01_fund_code t INNER JOIN fnd02_fund_info ON ( fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01_fund_code_id AND fnd02_work_date = ( SELECT MAX(fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info WHERE fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01_fund_code_id AND fnd02_work_date <= f_today() ) ) INNER JOIN fnd08_org_auth ON fnd08_fund_code_id = fnd01_fund_code_id WHERE fnd01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND fnd08_auth_yn = 'true' AND fnd01_close_yn IN ('false', #{c.closeYn}) AND fnd01_plan_yn = 'true' AND fnd02_kofia_fund_type_cd LIKE #{c.fundTypeCode} AND COALESCE(fnd02_kofia_class_type_cd, '%') LIKE #{c.classTypeCode} AND CONCAT(fnd01_fund_cd, fnd02_fund_nm) ILIKE #{c.fundName} ) tt LEFT OUTER JOIN closeFund ON closeFund.cd = tt.fnd01_close_yn LEFT OUTER JOIN kofiaFundType ON kofiaFundType.cd = tt.fnd02_kofia_fund_type_cd ORDER BY tt.fnd01_fund_cd
